-- name: Crendatha_Fe-Dhar
-- Generated by scripts/quests/velious-armor.mjs; edit the manifest/compiler, not this file.

-- No class/level hand-in gate. Quest faction prerequisites are intentionally bypassed.
-- Recipe quantities/rewards are P99-reviewed; reward magnitudes and limitations are documented in docs/velious-armor-quests.md.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("What do we have here? A cutthroat, perhaps? If you are a rogue, I may have use for you. I am in need of certain components and will reward you well if they are brought to me. Do I have your services?")
  end
  if e.message:findi("you have my services") then
    e.self:Say("Excellent. Now, down to business. I shall pay you in trade for the items I seek. What I have for you is as such, a coif, a breastplate, armplates, bracers, gauntlets, greaves and boots. These should aid you in your skullduggery.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("coif") then
    e.self:Say("I am in need of an unadorned chain coif and three crushed pieces of coral. For your services I shall give you a coif suitable for one such as you.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("breastplate") then
    e.self:Say("For the breastplate you must seek out an unadorned chain tunic and three flawless diamonds. Only then will you receive a breastplate of my crafting.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("armplate") then
    e.self:Say("For the armplates I shall give you, I require these: unadorned chain sleeves and three flawed emeralds.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("bracer") then
    e.self:Say("An unadorned bracer and three crushed flame emeralds are what I require of you. A bracer of my making is your reward.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("gauntlet") then
    e.self:Say("I need unadorned chain gauntlets and a set of three crushed topaz. Once I have these, you shall have your reward.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("greaves") then
    e.self:Say("A pair of leggings will be yours once you complete this task for me, thief. A pair of unadorned chain leggings and three flawed sea sapphires are all I require.")
  end
  if e.message:findi("boots") then
    e.self:Say("A fine pair of boots shall you have to skulk around in, once you bring me a pair of unadorned chain boots and three pieces of crushed black marble.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24968, item2 = 25831, item3 = 25831, item4 = 25831 }) then -- Shadow Crown
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(31126)
    e.other:AddEXP(175000)
    e.other:Faction(430, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -60, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24963, item2 = 25814, item3 = 25814, item4 = 25814 }) then -- Shadow Chestguard

    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(31128)
    e.other:AddEXP(175000)
    e.other:Faction(430, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 30, 0)

  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24967, item2 = 25838, item3 = 25838, item4 = 25838 }) then -- Shadow Bracer
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(31129)
    e.other:AddEXP(175000)
    e.other:Faction(430, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -60, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24969, item2 = 25832, item3 = 25832, item4 = 25832 }) then -- Shadow Gauntlets
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(31130)
    e.other:AddEXP(175000)
    e.other:Faction(430, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -60, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24964, item2 = 25825, item3 = 25825, item4 = 25825 }) then -- Shadow Greaves
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(31131)
    e.other:AddEXP(175000)
    e.other:Faction(430, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -60, 0)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 24966, item2 = 25833, item3 = 25833, item4 = 25833 }) then -- Shadow Boots
    e.self:Say("You have done well.")
    e.other:SummonItem(31132)
    e.other:AddEXP(175000)
    e.other:Faction(430, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, -60, 0)
  end
